fortune.title: Daily Fortune
fortune.subtitle: Enter birth date or BaZi pillars for reproducible daily hexagram and aspect scores.
fortune.disclaimer: For cultural entertainment and reflection only — not professional advice for health, finance, legal, or life decisions.
fortune.disclaimerShort: Entertainment reference only; not advice for real-world decisions.
fortune.name: Label
fortune.empty: Save a birth profile to see today's fortune here.
fortune.source.title: Fortune analysis source
fortune.source.method1: Set the day master ({{dayMaster}}) as the core and take meaning from five elements ({{element}}); if the hour pillar is used ({{hourUse}}), include it too.
fortune.source.method2: Use the local rule engine ({{engine}}) to compute the overall score, then split hexagram intent into five aspects: career, wealth, relationships, health, and mood.
fortune.source.method3: Interpret the hexagram text to produce summary and advice: {{hexagramName}} (#{{hexagramId}}), tendency {{tendency}}; if AI is enabled, it only polishes wording without changing the hexagram or scores.
fortune.source.fixedNote: Engine strings like local-v1/daymaster: local-v1 is the local rule version; daymaster is the school mapping. This rule engine is deterministic: the same profile on the same day yields the same result (not random each run).

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Local preferences — no account required
settings.mcp.hint: Configure local stdio or remote SSE MCP servers (MCP spec). Enabled tools are injected into workbench chats. Env vars below are injected into that server process when the app launches — no OS-level export needed.
settings.skillsDesc: Manage built-in and installed Agent Skills (SKILL.md). Use them from workbench Skills mode.
settings.skillsInstallHint: owner/repo/path, or a URL to SKILL.md.
settings.skillsCatalogsHint: Browse external catalogs, then paste a path back here to install.
settings.skillsInstalledHint: Built-in skills cannot be removed. Custom uninstall is permanent.
settings.mcp.name: Name
settings.mcp.envHint: e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN, BRAVE_API_KEY. Applies only to this MCP subprocess — not your shell profile.
settings.modelsHint: Add a provider (API) first, then models under it. Chat groups models by provider. Use checkboxes for image/video — no separate model config for multimodal.
settings.modelsPresetHint: Presets fill default URL, media protocol, and sample models — edit anytime. Add your own API key.
settings.modelsLocalHint: Local URLs can omit the API key. Start the local server first, then add a real model id (e.g. qwen2.5:7b).
settings.mediaProfileHint: Chooses which vendor protocol to use for image/video/music. Auto only guesses from Base URL. Which model can see or generate media is set with checkboxes below.
settings.mediaModelOptional: Empty = chat default or vendor default
settings.desktopWidget.desc: A circular always-on-top dial on your desktop. Hover to expand calendar details.
settings.desktopWidget.enabledHint: Shows immediately. Closing the dial does not turn this off — it will reopen on next launch.
settings.desktopWidget.keepAlive: Keep widget after closing main window
settings.desktopWidget.keepAliveHint: If the dial is visible when you close the main window, it stays on the desktop. Reopen the app from the tray.
settings.desktopWidget.dialFaceHint: Choose the look of the circular desktop dial.
settings.desktopWidget.backgroundHint: Optional local image for the dial face. Used images are kept in history below so you can switch or delete them later.
settings.desktopWidget.showTicksHint: Turn off when your background image already includes tick marks.
settings.appearanceDesc: Light/dark mode, brand color, and dial faces in one place.
settings.themeAccentHint: App brand color for buttons and highlights — independent of light/dark mode.
settings.fortuneDailyNotifyHint: When a birth profile exists and the app is running, notify once each day (entertainment only).
settings.fortuneNotifyHourHint: Notifies once after this hour is first reached.
settings.stocksDailyNotifyHint: Notify when a daily stocks report finishes (auto or manual).
settings.stocksMarketCNHint: When off, CN symbols are skipped in analysis.
settings.stocksMarketUSHint: When off, US symbols are skipped in analysis.
settings.stocksAutoGenerateHint: While the app is running, generate today’s report after the configured hour.
settings.stocksScannerMaxHint: Max scanner symbols sent into analysis.
settings.stocksMaxRecsHint: Max picks kept in the final report.
settings.stocksRangesHint: Which intervals to show on recommendation cards (all are still computed).
settings.fortuneProfileDesc: Shared by the Fortune agent and the Daily Fortune page.
settings.hexagramSchoolHint: Local mapping method; Day Master is the recommended default.
settings.fortuneAiPolishHint: Off by default; when enabled, the “Source & method” modal will add an AI analysis supplement (copy only; hexagram and scores stay the same).
settings.fortuneAiConfigHint: Configure a fully custom API endpoint and initial model.
settings.fortuneAiApiKeyPlaceholder: Required for cloud; optional for local
settings.fortuneAiModelHint: Input image/video = the chat model can see media. Output image/video/audio = that id is used for generation APIs. Text is always on.
settings.fortuneAiNeedModel: Add at least one model id first
settings.launchAtLoginHint: Start Qiankun when you sign in.
settings.backupDesc: Export or import a config pack for migration. Not a full app data dump.
settings.harnessDesc: Configure the coding sandbox and plugin directory. Plugins are Cordis-style hot-loaded modules under userData.
settings.harnessPluginsHint: Place plugin.json + index.mjs in subfolders under the directory above, then reload.
settings.harnessPluginsEmpty: No plugins found. The hello example is copied on first run.
settings.harnessContainerHint: Uses docker exec against a running container. Devcontainer.json in the sandbox root can auto-fill name/path when mode is container.
settings.backupIncludes: Includes: app settings (theme/locale/widget/models & API keys/MCP/notifications/stocks prefs), birth profile, watchlist, knowledge embedding settings, agent session traces and goals.
settings.backupExcludes: Excludes: custom agents, skills, knowledge documents & vectors, stock reports/quote caches, dial image files (paths only), sandbox workspace files and plugin sources.
settings.backupImported: Import complete. Some settings may need a restart.
